title: Querying with LINQ
description: Learn querying with linq in ASP.NET Core.

blocks.text: Write expressive queries using LINQ methods.

blocks.code:
var cheap = await _context.Products
    .Where(p => p.Price < 50)
    .OrderBy(p => p.Name)
    .Select(p => new { p.Name, p.Price })
    .ToListAsync();
